title: Exploring Cross-Cultural Differences in English Hate Speech Annotations: From Dataset Construction to Analysis

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing zero-shot LLM hate speech classification accuracies against ground-truth labels established by annotators from five distinct English-speaking countries (US, UK, Australia, Singapore, South Africa), testing culture-specific prompts, and analyzing pairwise label agreement among annotators from those different cultural backgrounds.
Conducting chi-squared tests to evaluate significant disparities in hate speech annotations across different annotator racial groups.
Conducting chi-squared tests to evaluate significant disparities in hate speech annotations across different annotator gender groups.
Conducting chi-squared tests to evaluate significant disparities in hate speech annotations based on the varying education levels of the annotators.
